title: MCP Catalog support tiers — deploy a Red Hat-supported MCP server

steps.caption: Every MCP server card in the AI Hub MCP Catalog carries a support tier — Red Hat, Partner, or Community — telling you who maintains and supports the server.
Filter the catalog by support tier — the Red Hat tier lists the servers that are fully supported by Red Hat.
Open the server details — review the provider, the tools the server exposes, and whether it requires a service account.
Deploy MCP server — the deployment dialog prefills the YAML from the catalog's server metadata; edit as needed.
The operator reports honest conditions: Accepted=False — the prefilled YAML references a ConfigMap the project does not have yet.
Fix the YAML: remove the missing ConfigMap storage block and keep the service account — created beforehand with oc create sa mcp-viewer.

details.label: Edited YAML
details.value: runtime + config only, storage block removed

steps.caption: Status Available — the MCP Lifecycle Operator provisioned the MCPServer custom resource, the Deployment, and the Service.
In the OpenShift console, the MCPServer custom resource shows READY and ACCEPTED True for the deployed server.
The CR's status conditions confirm the server: Accepted=True (Configuration is valid) and Ready=True — the operator turned the catalog card into a running workload.
